callout.heading: Most chat apps never show you how full the window is.
callout.body: <documented>Claude summarises older messages in the background</documented>; <unknown>the others document nothing about it</unknown>.

documented-for-claude.description: for users with code execution enabled, Claude summarises earlier messages when a conversation approaches the context limit [1].

the-only-sign.description: the page describes you occasionally seeing Claude "organizing its thoughts", and announces no notice each time; that it hides this on purpose is an inference [1].

anthropic-usage-and-length-limits.title: Anthropic, How do usage and length limits work?

full-history-is-kept.description: the whole chat is preserved so Claude can reference it after summarising [1].

a-summary-can-lose-things.description: Anthropic warns that over-aggressive compaction can lose subtle but critical context whose importance only shows later [1].

anthropic-context-engineering.title: Anthropic, Effective context engineering for AI agents

other-apps-are-unknown.description: no vendor page found documents summarising in ChatGPT, Gemini or Copilot, and a chat interface may instead drop the oldest content first [1]; OpenAI's compaction is documented for its API and is opaque [2].

her-own-notes.title: Her own notes
her-own-notes.script: Your sister doesn't keep the call. She keeps her own notes of it, a few scribbled lines: Mum's phone, the renovation, Pepper and the cake. A few lines instead of everything.

the-app-does-something-like-it.title: The app does something like it
the-app-does-something-like-it.script: The app does something like it. When a chat gets long, older messages can be squeezed into a short summary, so the conversation can go on instead of hitting the wall.

you-cant-watch-the-meter.title: You can't watch the meter
you-cant-watch-the-meter.script: And here is the catch: the chat looks the same. Every bubble is still there, so you can't rely on a gauge, you rely on habits.

why-the-budget-survived.title: Why the budget survived
why-the-budget-survived.script: Why did the budget survive here? Because you flagged the 12,300 over budget just before, so it was fresh when the summary was written, and the plan fits 30,000 euro again. That was timing.
